description.value: Coast Osoyoos Beach Hotel is a family-friendly waterfront property sitting directly on Osoyoos Lake, in BC's warmest and sunniest corner of the Okanagan Valley. The hotel features a Spanish-inspired façade, indoor pool with waterslide, private beach with free beach chairs, and a putting green, making it one of the more distinctive full-amenity hotels in town. Touring cyclists will find it a convenient hub for the area's wine routes, lake paddling, and Okanagan hiking trails, with restaurants and cafes reachable on foot.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content is fully fetched and provides strong confirmation of address, phone, and email matching OSM tags. Free Wi-Fi is explicitly stated in the room description ('free wi-fi'); nearby restaurants and cafes within walking distance are mentioned on the front page. No mention of bike storage, bike procedures, laundry, e-bike charging, or tools appears anywhere in the fetched content, so those fields remain null. A minor template anomaly appears in the FAQ subpage ('Hotel 116, a Coast Hotel') but all other content clearly refers to Coast Osoyoos Beach Hotel.
concerns: FAQ subpage contains the phrase 'Find answers to your questions about Hotel 116, a Coast Hotel' — appears to be a CMS template error from the Coast Hotels chain; all other content correctly identifies the property as Coast Osoyoos Beach Hotel.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active, publicly bookable hotel with a functioning website and confirmed contact details. Clearly open and accessible to touring cyclists.

Nearby evening food.detail: Website states 'Stroll from our hotel to one of the many restaurants and cafes within walking distance.'

wow_evidence: indoor pool with waterslide, private beach with free beach chairs... sitting directly on Osoyoos Lake

price.label: Mid-range
price.signal: Coast beachfront family hotel, Osoyoos; shoulder $160-200, summer peak
